title: Federated Learning for Clinical Structured Data: A Benchmark Comparison of Engineering and Statistical Approaches
reasoning: The paper discusses data privacy as a motivation for Federated Learning, which is an ethical concern. However, the core of the paper is a technical benchmark comparing FL frameworks based on performance metrics (bias, prediction accuracy, communication cost), not an evaluation or benchmarking of ethical frameworks, morals, or faith. The ethical aspect serves as a justification for the methods, not the subject of evaluation.
